# JZZ1 - Architectural Aluminum Windows and Doors Manufacturer

> Factory-direct architectural aluminum building systems manufacturer based in Jinan, Shandong, China, holding Australian Standard AS 2047 StandardsMark Licence SMK41678 by Intertek SAI Global and AS/NZS 2208 safety glazing certification by CSi, specializing in commercial and residential windows, doors, profiles, curtain walls, railings, and sunrooms for project buyers and distributors in Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and global project markets.

## Core Systems & Product Hubs
- [Architectural Aluminum Windows Hub](https://www.jzz1.com/products/windows.html): Thermal break and non-thermal casement, sliding, tilt-and-turn, and awning window systems with double/triple glazing options.
- [Thermal Break Aluminum Windows](https://www.jzz1.com/products/thermal-break-aluminum-windows.html): PA66 GF25 polyamide thermal barrier systems, Low-E IGUs, and low U-value configurations.
- [Casement Aluminum Windows](https://www.jzz1.com/products/casement-aluminum-windows.html): Outward opening, inward opening, and multi-point perimeter compression locking systems.
- [Sliding Aluminum Windows](https://www.jzz1.com/products/sliding-aluminum-windows.html): High wind pressure 2-track and 3-track sliding windows with integrated 304 stainless mesh.
- [Aluminum Doors Hub](https://www.jzz1.com/products/doors.html): Heavy-duty sliding patio doors, bi-fold doors, slim-frame pivot doors, and commercial entrance systems.
- [Aluminum Entrance Doors](https://www.jzz1.com/products/aluminum-entrance-doors.html): Architectural luxury pivot entrance doors and commercial swing doors with multipoint locking.
- [Aluminum Curtain Wall Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/products/aluminum-curtain-wall-systems.html): Unitized, semi-unitized, and stick facade systems engineered for high-rise wind loads.
- [Custom Aluminum Extrusions & Profiles](https://www.jzz1.com/products/profiles.html): 6063-T5 / 6061-T6 alloy profiles, anodized, PVDF, and powder-coated finishes for distributors and fabricators.
- [Custom Aluminum Extrusion Dies](https://www.jzz1.com/products/custom-aluminum-extrusion-profiles.html): Drawing-based precision die tooling, custom section profiles, and OEM extrusions.
- [Powder Coated Aluminum Profiles](https://www.jzz1.com/products/powder-coated-aluminum-profiles.html): AkzoNobel & Qualicoat Class 2 certified exterior architectural finishes.
- [Glass Railings & Balustrades](https://www.jzz1.com/products/railings.html): Frameless and spigot-mounted structural laminated glass railing systems.
- [Aluminum Balcony Railings](https://www.jzz1.com/products/aluminum-balcony-railings.html): Picket, glass shoe base, and terrace balustrade systems for residential towers.
- [Sunrooms & Glass Enclosures](https://www.jzz1.com/products/sunrooms.html): Thermal-isolated aluminum roof structures, skylights, and architectural glass conservatories.
- [Outdoor Aluminum Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/products/outdoor-aluminum-systems.html): Coordinated balcony railings, garden fences, and motorized driveway gates.
- [Aluminum Garden Fences](https://www.jzz1.com/products/aluminum-garden-fences.html): Perimeter picket fences, privacy louvers, and villa garden boundaries.
- [Aluminum Garden Gates](https://www.jzz1.com/products/aluminum-garden-gates.html): Pedestrian swing gates and driveway sliding gates with zero-rust marine coating.
- [Outdoor Aluminum Gates](https://www.jzz1.com/products/outdoor-aluminum-gates.html): Heavy-duty access gates and villa boundary entry solutions.
- [uPVC Windows & Doors](https://www.jzz1.com/products/upvc-windows-and-doors.html): Multi-chamber galvanized steel reinforced uPVC window systems for acoustic insulation.
- [uPVC Profiles](https://www.jzz1.com/products/upvc-profiles.html): Lead-free PVC extrusions for sliding and casement fabrication.
- [OEM & Private Label Supply](https://www.jzz1.com/oem-aluminum-window-supplier.html): Turnkey OEM manufacturing, branded hardware, custom carton labeling, and container optimization.

## Australia & New Zealand Certified Sourcing
- [Australian Standard Windows & Doors (AS 2047 & AS/NZS 2208)](https://www.jzz1.com/australia.html): StandardsMark Licence SMK41678 certified by Intertek SAI Global for MD75S tilt-and-turn (ULS 4000 Pa, SLS 1600 Pa, Water 600 Pa) and MD76A awning systems (ULS 3000 Pa, SLS 800 Pa, Water 200 Pa); CSi Licence 7632 for AS/NZS 2208 safety glazing. Full National Construction Code (NCC / BCA) compliance.
- [Official Certificates & Compliance Center](https://www.jzz1.com/certificates.html): Traceable third-party certifications, JAS-ANZ accredited licences, NATA laboratory test data, and Form 15 compliance documents.
- [AS 2047 Sourcing Checklist](https://www.jzz1.com/knowledge-base/as2047-windows-and-doors-sourcing-checklist.html): Australian building certifier requirements, NATA test reports, and Form 15 documentation.
- [AS 2047 Bifold Doors Guide](https://www.jzz1.com/guides/as2047-bifold-doors-for-australia-housing-projects.html): Large-span folding door configurations for Australian residential developments.

## Performance Engineering & Specialized Solutions
- [Solutions Hub](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/index.html): Performance-led fenestration engineering for extreme climate, acoustic, and structural criteria.
- [High Wind Load Window & Door Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/high-wind-load-systems.html): Structural mullions and heavy interlocks tested for up to 3000–4500 Pa design wind pressure.
- [Energy Efficiency & Thermal Performance](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/energy-efficiency.html): Low U-value fenestration, warm edge spacers, and Argon-filled insulated glass.
- [Low-E Glass & Solar Control](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/low-e-glass.html): Hard coat vs soft coat Low-E, solar heat gain coefficient (SHGC) control, and daylight transmittance.
- [Triple Glazing Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/triple-glazing.html): Dual-cavity insulated glass units for extreme cold climate and high acoustic isolation.
- [Thermal Break Profiles](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/thermal-break-profiles.html): Polyamide PA66 GF25 thermal isolators for condensation control and thermal barriers.
- [Thermal Break Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/thermal-break-systems.html): Architectural window and door packages engineered for passive house and energy-code compliance.
- [Coastal Corrosion Resistance](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/coastal-corrosion-resistance.html): Marine-grade powder coating, fluorocarbon PVDF, and 316 stainless steel fasteners.
- [Impact-Resistant Glazing](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/impact-resistant-options.html): SGP and PVB laminated safety glass engineered for hurricane and typhoon wind zones.
- [Multi-Point Lock Systems](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/multi-point-lock-systems.html): Perimeter multi-locking hardware for forced-entry resistance and acoustic compression.
- [Weather Sealing & Security](https://www.jzz1.com/solutions/weather-security.html): Continuous vulcanized EPDM gaskets and engineered drainage sill designs.

## Regional Engineering & Market Fit
- [Singapore Project Standards](https://www.jzz1.com/singapore.html): BCA Green Mark compliance, acoustic performance (STC 35–44 dB), and SS 341 testing alignment.
- [Malaysia Commercial & Residential](https://www.jzz1.com/malaysia.html): High-humidity tropical thermal performance, powder-coated finishes, and large-span sliding systems.
- [Indonesia Development Projects](https://www.jzz1.com/indonesia.html): High-rainfall sealing (EPDM triple-gasketed), earthquake-resilient frame engineering for Jakarta, Surabaya, and Bali developments.
- [Philippines High Wind Load & Typhoon Proofing](https://www.jzz1.com/philippines.html): NSCP 2015 wind load certified (up to 3.0 kPa), heavy-duty reinforced mullions, factory-direct export.
- [Vietnam Industrial & Residential](https://www.jzz1.com/vietnam.html): Industrial park fenestration, factory roller shutters, and acoustic high-rise residential systems.
- [Thailand Coastal & Hospitality](https://www.jzz1.com/thailand.html): Seaside villa sliding doors, solar-reflective glass, and tropical marine powder coating.
- [France Architectural Sourcing](https://www.jzz1.com/france.html): CE-compliant thermal break windows and custom architectural extrusions.
- [Italy Design & Building Sourcing](https://www.jzz1.com/italy.html): Slim-profile casement windows, luxury pivot entrance doors, and drawing-based fabrication.
- [Spain Project Sourcing](https://www.jzz1.com/spain.html): Thermal insulation systems, acoustic hotel balcony doors, and custom extrusions.

## Factory, Quality & Testing Credentials
- [Manufacturing Facility & CNC Production](https://www.jzz1.com/factory.html): 12,000+ sqm manufacturing facility in Jinan, Shandong, 4 CNC cutting lines, automated IGU assembly, and ISO 9001 certified process control.
- [Project References & Portfolio](https://www.jzz1.com/projects.html): International references across luxury villas, high-rise condominiums, resort hospitality, and commercial facades.
- [Quality Assurance & Inspection Protocols](https://www.jzz1.com/quality.html): Diagonal tolerance, water tightness, air infiltration, and acoustic field testing.
- [Technical Standards & Testing](https://www.jzz1.com/technical-standards.html): AS 2047-2014, AS/NZS 2208, AS 1288, ASTM E330, EN 12210, AAMA 2605, BCA SS 341, and NSCP 2015 test compliance.
